profile_text.body:
Ericsson is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, traded under the ticker ERIC. According to its own site, it powers the networks that connect billions, spanning 5G, AI-driven automation, cloud, and work toward 6G. The company describes its direction as building networks into a programmable, autonomous, and AI-native intelligent fabric, and says it is developing trusted AI for networks. It also points to enterprise connectivity that unites 5G, AI, and cloud, and to advanced 5G capabilities such as network slicing, orchestration, and AI-driven tools.

The site material also covers the company's view of AI moving into the physical world and what that could mean for the role of communications service providers in the AI economy. It cites AT&T's Open Radio Access Network (Open RAN) transformation as laying the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network, which the company says will accelerate innovation and network automation.

Beyond the site text, the record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the company. Its profile gives the CIK as 0000717826 and lists the aliases ERICSSON LM TELEPHONE CO and ERICSSON (LM) TEL-SP ADR.
